_comment: Носители элементов экрана кампании (openspec: map-screen-full-copy, шаг 3; T-247/T-246/T-244/T-245/T-243). Отдельно от spec.json (тот — разведка стиля) и от map_spec.json (тот — графика поля): здесь производственный прогон одного утверждённого режима для мелких UI-носителей, список сюжетов = реестр элементов game/scripts/ui/campaign_screen_map.gd, у которого нет рисунка. Эталон signs — семейство медальонных сигилов макета; эталон plates — интерфейс-кадр. Слои запроса: style категории -> style варианта -> frame категории -> subject.

variants.name: u1_iron_parchment
variants.style: hand-painted game interface asset, matte painted rendering, soft warm key light from the upper left, dark iron and tarnished brass on aged parchment, limited earthy palette of browns #664328 #a46739 #ca9861 and dull gold, crisp readable silhouette, visible brush texture, no photorealism, no glossy shaders
variants.negative: photograph, photorealism, 3d render, cgi, glossy plastic, shiny enamel, anime, cartoon, line art, sketch, text, letters, numbers, digits, watermark, logo, signature, ui, interface, panel, screen, frame around the canvas, border, vignette, drop shadow, lens flare, depth of field, blur, noise, jpeg artifacts, multiple objects, collage, grid of variants

signs.style: circular engraved metal medallion sigils, dark iron disc with fine beaded rim and ornamental engraving, one luminous glyph at the center, strong contrast of dark metal and glowing symbol, flat front view
signs.frame: one circular medallion sigil, whole object with a clear empty margin around it, nothing touching the frame, centered, isolated on plain white background, brand mark design
